title: Epistle rem early
english: Rem early: Epistle; historia and theoria toward orthodox doctrine.
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 77; Ad episcopos Libyae et Pentapoleos via Khazarzar (Ad episcopos qui sunt in Libya et Pentapoli.pdf).
